## 1.3.33 (HexGhoul): the crystal launcher rebuilt as a real gun with a rifle hold and twice the fire rate; both hands stay on two-handed quinques through every combo; new M1s for every quinque; a tap of right click folds a quinque back into its case; investigators dash left and right with brief afterimages (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.33 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 66**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, every pose checked in offline renders, **not tried in game**.

- **The launcher is a gun now.** It's built from scratch: a skeleton stock with a glowing seam, a white receiver (the case becomes it) with a glowing Ukaku crystal feed and two crystals on top, a raked pistol grip with a trigger and guard, a dark hand guard with glowing vents, a fore grip, a round barrel, a front sight and a slotted muzzle brake. It isn't a box with tubes any more. In first person it sits lower right, pointing at the crosshair.
- **A rifle hold.** Bladed stance (feet and chest turned, left shoulder to the target), stock in the right shoulder, cheek down on it, the right hand on the pistol grip and the left on the fore grip, barrel along the look. Investigators and players (third person) raise and lower it as they look up and down. Each shot kicks the muzzle up a little.
- **It fires twice as fast.** About 10 shards a second while you hold use (each pull fires a pair two ticks apart), faster shards (2.8), a little lighter each (2.0). Held down, it fires about 6 seconds before it overheats. Investigators fire 8-shard bursts at the same rate.
- **Both hands stay on two-handed quinques.** The spear, katana, mace and launcher put the left hand back on its grip every frame (it's worked out from where the weapon really is in the right hand), through stances, every M1, parries, recoil and running. The spear's front hand slides along the shaft as you thrust, like a real spear. The mace's lower hand can slide down its handle.
- **New stances and M1s for every quinque**, each a smooth wind-up, cut and follow-through with a step-in on the big blows:
  - **Katana:** chudan guard; a diagonal cut down from the right shoulder, a rising cut back the other way, then an overhead cut down the middle with a long step.
  - **Spear:** low and level at the hip; two thrusts driven along the shaft (chest turning to draw it back, hips going in), then a deep lunging thrust.
  - **Mace:** raised in both hands; a smash down across the front, a backhand swing, then a two-handed overhead slam into the ground.
  - **Bikaku blade:** en garde, the blade now held at a natural wrist angle, not square to the arm (it used to look like the hand held the wrong end); a flat cut right to left, a rising cut, an overhead chop.
  - **Launcher:** a jab with the muzzle brake when something gets too close.
- **Tap right click to fold a melee quinque.** No more Shift. Holding the button down doesn't flip it open and shut again. The launcher fires on right click, so it still folds with Shift + right click.
- **Investigators are quicker on their feet.** In a fight they slip left and right between blows (and between bursts if they shoot), and dash in on someone just out of reach. They check for walls and drops first. Each dash leaves 3-4 brief afterimages, a cold white, gone in a third of a second.

Untested in game: all of it is compiled, unit tested and checked in offline renders only. Try: `/summon hexkagune:ccg_investigator` (a partner comes with it), or hold a quinque case (`/give @s hexkagune:quinque_case_launcher`, `..._katana`, `..._koukaku`, `..._mace`, `..._bikaku`) and right click it.
